slots.name: Hilton win chance
slots.sentence: California hasn’t elected a Republican statewide in two decades, and Decision Desk HQ considers the governor’s mansion solidly Democratic — giving Hilton a 3-percent chance of turning the seat red.

slots.name: Hispanic population share
slots.sentence: Frustration over the president’s immigration agenda now appears to be a main factor, along with economic woes, driving Hispanic voters — who make up roughly 40% of the Golden State — away from Trump this cycle.

slots.name: debate date
slots.sentence: Former Health Secretary Xavier Becerra (D) and Republican Steve Hilton, a former Fox News host, clashed on the debate stage Wednesday as they jostle in a contentious race to replace California Gov. Gavin Newsom (D).

slots.name: debate host
slots.sentence: The rivals sparred over the economy, immigration and healthcare in an hourlong CNN debate, the first and only scheduled just days before ballots go out to California voters.
